query.description: GDS Map 저장 작업 생성 (Device당 1건 / UPLOADING)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB (IMPORT_JOB_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, JOB_STATUS, EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNT, EXPECTED_PLACED_COUNT, EXPECTED_POINT_COUNT, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER) VALUES (:import_job_seq, :factory, :device_id, 'UPLOADING', :expected_source_count, :expected_placed_count, :expected_point_count, :create_user, :update_user)

query.description: 저장 작업 번호 채번 (기존 SELECT_NEXT_STEP_SEQ와 같은 방식)
GDS Map 저장 작업 조회 (작업 번호)
query.commandtext: SELECT IMPORT_JOB_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, JOB_STATUS, EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNT, EXPECTED_PLACED_COUNT, EXPECTED_POINT_COUNT, RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT, RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT, RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq

query.description: GDS Map 저장 작업 조회 (Factory / Device)
query.commandtext: SELECT IMPORT_JOB_SEQ, FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, JOB_STATUS, EXPECTED_SOURCE_COUNT, EXPECTED_PLACED_COUNT, EXPECTED_POINT_COUNT, RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT, RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT, RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id

query.description: 배치 저장 후 수신 건수 누적 (UPLOADING 작업만)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB SET RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT = RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT + :received_source, RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT = RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT + :received_placed, RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT = RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT + :received_point, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq AND JOB_STATUS = 'UPLOADING'

query.description: 완료 확정: DB에서 다시 센 건수로 수신 건수를 맞추고 READY로 변경 (UPLOADING 작업만)
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB SET JOB_STATUS = 'READY', RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT = :received_source, RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT = :received_placed, RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT = :received_point, UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq AND JOB_STATUS = 'UPLOADING'

query.description: 진행 중(UPLOADING / VALIDATING) 저장 작업 취소. UPDATE_TIME은 DEFAULT로 갱신되지 않아 직접 기록
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB SET JOB_STATUS = 'CANCELLED', UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE IMPORT_JOB_SEQ = :import_job_seq AND JOB_STATUS IN ('UPLOADING', 'VALIDATING')
